args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 (the latest deploy) failed health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an error rate of ~18%. Rolled back production to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Rollback verified as rolled out in all regions. v2.3.1 should be investigated and not redeployed until root cause is identified.
args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: checkout-api was on v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and failing health checks with an ~18% error rate. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was unhealthy.
2. **Rolled back**: Deployed v2.3.0 — the most recent release with a healthy history in production — to all production regions. The rollback is verified as rolled out.
3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy") documenting the failure and the rollback, and the on-call engineer has been paged.

transcript.content: I'll first look at the deployment history to find the most recent healthy release.

transcript.content: The current version v2.3.1 is unhealthy (18% error rate), and the most recent healthy release was v2.3.0. I'll roll back to it now.
transcript.reasoning_content: Most recent healthy version: v2.3.0. Current v2.3.1 is unhealthy. Roll back to v2.3.0. Rollback itself — the policy says deploying a version never healthy requires approval; v2.3.0 was healthy, so rollback is fine. Then create incident.

transcript.content: The rollback to v2.3.0 completed in all regions. Now I'll open the SEV2 incident.
